basis: Homeobox TF expressed in the QC that maintains distal stem cells (Sarkar et al. 2007 Nature). Named by Shahan 2022 without a locus and not used by any of the four datasets; ID from UniProt Q8H1D2. Update 2026-10-20: promoter of the Li 2016 WOX5 sort, 130 FPKM there vs 24 in COR and 11 in CO2 (sorted bulk RNA-seq).

WIP zinc finger; QC reporter marker line (Lee et al. 2006 PNAS) used in Shahan 2022 spatial mapping; not in Shahan top-50 QC DE. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 WOX5 (QC) sort 38 FPKM vs <=5 in every other sorted population; independent of Lee 2006, so medium to high.

L-type lectin receptor kinase; QC+columella in Shahan 2022 list (from Wendrich 2020) and QC DE (lfc 4.7, pct 0.90 vs 0.04); PHYTOMap in situ at the tip, QC and columella not resolved (Nobori 2023). Agreement raises low to medium; not QC-exclusive.

Root meristem growth factor 10 peptide (CLELn); Shahan 2022 QC DE (lfc 4.7, pct 0.76 vs 0.05) and columella DE (pct 0.18). Conflict: skill arabidopsis_root.tsv lists it as an uncharacterized Columella gene.
TERMINAL EAR1-like RNA-binding protein; QC-enriched in Denyer 2019 and Shahan 2022 DE (pct 0.82 vs 0.17, so not specific). Denyer 2019 cells are part of the Shahan atlas, so not independent.

AP2 TF forming the stem-cell-niche gradient (Aida et al. 2004 Cell); Shahan 2022 QC DE (pct 0.98 vs 0.09) and PHYTOMap in situ at the tip (Nobori 2023). Not QC-specific. Two studies raise medium to high.

Root meristem growth factor peptide (GLV11/CLEL8) maintaining the stem-cell niche, expressed in QC/columella stem cells (Matsuzaki et al. 2010 Science); in Shahan 2022 marker lists, not in its top-50 DE.
NAC TF for root-cap maturation and sloughing; reporter in outer columella and LRC layers (Kamiya et al. 2016 Development). Shared with LRC.
NAC TF (with BRN1/SMB) for root-cap maturation; outer columella + LRC reporter (Kamiya et al. 2016 Development). Shared with LRC.

LAZY-family gravity signalling gene acting in columella (Taniguchi et al. 2017 Plant Cell). Conflict: Shahan 2022 DE is higher in its QC label (pct 0.66) than columella (0.16), consistent with that QC label holding columella stem cells. Skill table grades it expression/low.
RGF peptide expressed in proximal columella (Matsuzaki et al. 2010 Science); Shahan 2022 SEMITONES marker; not in top-50 DE.
Plastid outer-envelope pore protein (statolith amyloplasts); PHYTOMap in situ at the tip, QC and columella not resolved (Nobori 2023; panel label 'Meristematic-Columella').
Uncharacterized; distal-columella SEMITONES marker picked from single-cell data (Shahan 2022).
SOMBRERO NAC TF controlling root-cap maturation and LRC identity; reporter + mutant (Willemsen et al. 2008 Plant Cell; Kamiya et al. 2016). Also columella.
SKU5-similar multicopper oxidase; LRC DE in Shahan 2022 (lfc 5.3, pct 0.78 vs 0.05; Ryu 2019 list). Ryu 2019 cells are in the Shahan atlas, so one study.
Uncharacterized protein; PHYTOMap in situ in root cap and young epidermis (Nobori 2023 Fig 1e). Panel table calls it Elongating-Atrichoblast: use with SMB.

HD-ZIP IV TF specifying non-hair fate (Masucci et al. 1996; Lee & Schiefelbein 2002); Shahan 2022 DE (pct 0.63 vs 0.07); PHYTOMap weak (Nobori 2023). In Lee 2025 GL2 is only in shoot epidermis clusters.
MYB TF for non-hair fate in position-dependent patterning (Lee & Schiefelbein 1999 Cell); also expressed in LRC, so not specific in tip data.
Defense-related protein (uncharacterized); PHYTOMap in situ in mature non-hair epidermis (Nobori 2023).
bHLH required for root-hair initiation (Menand et al. 2007 Science); in Shahan 2022 marker lists and Lee 2025 trichoblast DE (independent nuclei data).
RHD6-like bHLH for root-hair development (Menand et al. 2007 Science); PHYTOMap in situ in hair-cell cluster 7 (Nobori 2023).
RSL bHLH for root-hair growth (Yi et al. 2010 Nat Genet); Shahan 2022 DE (lfc 5.7, pct 0.44 vs 0.01) and Lee 2025 6 d hair-cluster DE.
bHLH controlling root-hair elongation (Yi et al. 2010 Nat Genet); in Lee 2025 trichoblast DE only.

LRL bHLH (bHLH82) for root-hair growth; reporter (Lee et al. 2006 PNAS); Shahan 2022 DE (lfc 6.8, pct 0.66 vs 0.03), PHYTOMap in situ (Nobori 2023), Lee 2025 DE at all stages. Nobori's LRL3-high cluster 10 is mislabelled Endodermis.
COBRA-like protein required for root-hair tip growth (Brady et al. 2007; Huang 2017); Shahan 2022 DE (pct 0.54 vs 0.03) and Lee 2025 DE at all stages.
Root-hair-specific expansin with the RHE cis element (Cho & Cosgrove 2002 Plant Cell); Shahan 2022 DE (lfc 6.4, pct 0.49 vs 0.03) and Lee 2025 DE.
Root-hair cell-wall LRR-extensin needed for hair morphogenesis (Baumberger et al. 2001 Genes Dev); Shahan 2022 DE (lfc 5.6, pct 0.44 vs 0.02) and Lee 2025 DE.
NADPH oxidase for root-hair tip growth (Foreman et al. 2003 Nature); Lee 2025 hair pseudotime only.
Extensin; hair-cell enriched (Denyer 2019, Shahan 2022 lists) and in Lee 2025 trichoblast DE (independent nuclei data). Agreement raises low to medium.
Proline-rich cell-wall protein with root-hair-specific promoter (Bernhardt & Tierney 2000 Plant Physiol); Lee 2025 3 d hair DE and pseudotime.

Cell-wall invertase inhibitor; Shahan 2022 cortex DE (lfc 5.4, pct 0.72 vs 0.08) and PHYTOMap in situ in cortex clusters 5/6 (Nobori 2023). Two studies raise medium to high. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 COR sort 153 FPKM (CO2 23, APL 20); third study agrees.

Aspartyl protease; pCORTEX reporter imaged in Shahan 2022 (Fig 7; Lee et al. 2006 marker); cortex DE pct 0.50 vs 0.11. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 COR sort (pCORTEX line) 151 FPKM vs <=18 elsewhere; sorted-population enrichment is independent of Shahan 2022, so medium to high.

Putative proline-rich cell-wall protein (DEG27); Co2 cortex reporter of primary root (Heidstra et al. 2004 Genes Dev; Shahan 2022 list). Conflict: Lyu 2025 reporter (15/15) marks mature phloem parenchyma in secondary-growth roots, which have no cortex. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 CO2 sort 23 FPKM but WOX5 sort 25 (ground-tissue initials), others <=3; meristematic cortex/initials only. Kept medium because of the Lyu 2025 conflict.

Lipid-transfer protein family (uncharacterized); cortex marker in Efroni 2015 and Denyer 2019, Shahan 2022 DE (lfc 5.4, pct 0.74 vs 0.04). Specific to one lineage, so medium. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 COR sort 170 FPKM vs max 4 elsewhere (ratio ~40); independent sorted-population agreement raises medium to high (still expression-only, no known function).
Homeodomain-like superfamily protein (uncharacterized); cortex in Shahan 2022 list (from Wendrich 2020). Conflict: diffuse in PHYTOMap and top gene of Nobori's 'Pericycle' cluster 13.
IAA carboxyl methyltransferase; Ryu 2019 cortex marker in the Shahan/scKB curated list (skill table medium); Li 2016 COR sort 44 FPKM vs max 3 elsewhere. Two studies agree, so medium. Mature cortex.
GA 3-oxidase 1; Li 2016 COR 89 and CO2 38 FPKM, max other 5 (bulk only).
Nitrate transporter NPF6.4; Li 2016 COR 31 FPKM, max other 7 (CO2) (bulk only). Mature cortex.
Cytochrome P450; Li 2016 COR 53 FPKM, max other 5 (bulk only). Mature cortex.
GRAS TF for endodermis/cortex specification (Di Laurenzio et al. 1996 Cell); Shahan 2022 DE (pct 0.61 vs 0.07) and PHYTOMap in situ (Nobori 2023). Also QC and cortex/endodermis initials.

MYB TF activating Casparian strip genes (Kamiya et al. 2015 PNAS; Liberman et al. 2015 PNAS); reporter in Shahan 2022 (DE pct 0.87 vs 0.02), PHYTOMap in situ (Nobori 2023), seedling MERFISH (Lee 2025).

Casparian strip membrane domain protein (Roppolo et al. 2011 Nature); in Lee 2025 6 d endodermis and 3 d c14 DE. Shahan 2022 names CASP1 without a locus; ID from UniProt. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 E30 (mature endodermis) sort 13068 FPKM, SCR sort 1180, others <=187.
Casparian strip membrane domain protein (Roppolo et al. 2011 Nature); Shahan/Ryu 2019 curated list and Lee 2025 endodermis DE.
Casparian strip membrane domain protein (Roppolo et al. 2011 Nature); Shahan/Ryu 2019 curated list and Lee 2025 endodermis DE.
Casparian strip membrane domain protein (Roppolo et al. 2011 Nature); Shahan 2022 DE (pct 0.70 vs 0.02) and seedling MERFISH (Lee 2025).
Dirigent-domain protein required for Casparian strip lignin (Hosmani et al. 2013 PNAS); Lee 2025 endodermis DE.
Uclacyanin; Shahan 2022 endodermis DE (lfc 5.1, pct 0.87 vs 0.03) and seedling MERFISH 'endodermis and vascular' (Lee 2025). Not endodermis-only in situ.
Organic cation transporter; Shahan 2022 list (Wendrich 2020) and DE (pct 0.50 vs 0.007); PHYTOMap panel 'differentiating endodermis' (Nobori 2023), though it also drives Nobori's epidermis cluster 0.
GPI-anchored protein; endodermis by PHYTOMap in situ, cluster 9 (Nobori 2023).

Suberin fatty-acid omega-hydroxylase with endodermis-specific promoter (Hofer et al. 2008 J Exp Bot); marks suberized (mature) endodermis; also periderm in secondary growth. In the Lee 2025 suberin cluster (12 d c13, label inferred).
ABC transporter of monolignols; Lee 2025 6 d endodermis DE and seedling spatial. Conflict: Lee's own curated list places it in maturing phloem-pole pericycle.

Xylem-pole pericycle reporter (Schurholz et al. 2018 Plant Physiol); Shahan 2022 XPP marker. XPP subtype. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 S17 sort 613 and S4 247 FPKM, others <=17; independent agreement raises medium to high. Pole: the S17 line is a phloem-pole pericycle reporter (Otero 2022), yet the S17 bulk is XPP-rich, so the sort holds non-phloem-pole pericycle too.
GATA TF specifying lateral-root founder cells in xylem-pole pericycle (De Rybel et al. 2010 Curr Biol); stage-restricted; Shahan 2022 XPP DE (pct 0.27 vs 0.04). Skill table has it high.
source: 10.1016/j.devcel.2022.01.008; De Rybel et al. 2010 Curr Biol

basis: bHLH TF; Shahan 2022 phloem-pole pericycle DE (pct 0.95 vs 0.19) and PHYTOMap in situ in pericycle cluster 16 (Nobori 2023). Not specific (pct2 0.19).
MADS TF; Shahan 2022 phloem-pole pericycle DE (pct 0.90 vs 0.12). Conflict: Nobori 2023 panel calls it Elongating-Phloem (stele cluster 8).
LOB-domain TF; pericycle initials in Shahan 2022 list (Wendrich 2020); broad and weak in the stele by PHYTOMap (Nobori 2023).

Phosphate exporter for xylem loading, expressed in root pericycle and xylem parenchyma (Hamburger et al. 2002 Plant Cell). Co-occurs with NPF7.3/FRD3 in Lee 2025 6 d c7 / 3 d c9 (labelled phloem; reassignment inferred). Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 S17 (pericycle) sort 245, S4 75 FPKM, others <=23; sorted-population agreement raises medium to high. Also xylem parenchyma per Hamburger 2002.

Nitrate efflux for xylem loading in pericycle cells near protoxylem (Lin et al. 2008 Plant Cell). Lee 2025 6 d c7 / 3 d c9 (cell type inferred). Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 S17 84 and S4 86 FPKM, others <=5; sorted-population agreement raises medium to high.

Citrate efflux MATE in root pericycle for iron translocation (Durrett et al. 2007 Plant Physiol). Lee 2025 6 d c7 / 3 d c9 (cell type inferred). Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 S17 33 FPKM, max other 3; sorted-population agreement raises medium to high.

Outward K+ channel loading K+ into the xylem, expressed in pericycle and xylem parenchyma (Gaymard et al. 1998 Cell; characterized_markers.tsv, high). Li 2016 S17 pericycle sort 37 FPKM, max other 2. Shared with xylem parenchyma (separate row). Caution: in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting-induced gene list.
LOB-domain TF; Li 2016 S17 30 FPKM, max other 3 (bulk only). Caution: in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting-induced gene list.
Lipid-transfer protein; Li 2016 S17 305, S4 31, S18 6 FPKM in 5-6 d roots. Conflicts with the Lyu 2025 xylem-parenchyma call (secondary growth); see Xylem_Parenchyma row.

bZIP6; promoter of the S17 phloem-pole pericycle (PPP) sorting line, expressed in PPP shootward of the unloading zone (Otero 2022 ED1a). Li 2016 S17 sort 53 vs APL 45 FPKM, so weakly specific. Phloem-pole subtype. Caution: in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting-induced gene list.
Methylesterase 7; pMES7::VENUSer marks mature phloem-pole pericycle (Otero 2022 ED1c). Li 2016 S17 sort 115 vs APL 37 FPKM, others <=24. Independent agreement, so high. Phloem-pole subtype.
Callose synthase 8; Otero 2022 PPP marker 'according to microscopy' (no image in the accessible text); Li 2016 S17 44, APL 22 FPKM, others <=14. Agreement raises low to medium. Phloem-pole subtype.
GRAS TF transcribed in the stele, protein moves to endodermis (Helariutta et al. 2000 Cell). Not in the four datasets' tables; carried from the skill table, ID from UniProt.
Argonaute expressed in provasculature, sequestering miR165/166 (Nagawa 2006 lists); Shahan/scKB curated list. Skill table grades it function.
Aux/IAA; procambium + xylem in Shahan 2022 list (Wendrich 2020); not specific.
GPI-anchored LTP (xylogen-like); reporter in cambium 23/23 roots (Lyu 2025 Fig 1c). Secondary-growth roots.
Thaumatin-like protein; cambium reporter 14/14 (Lyu 2025). Secondary-growth roots.
AP2 TF of cambium stem cells (Eswaran et al. 2024 Science); weakly detected in Lyu 2025 (UMAP only). Secondary-growth roots.

MYB-related TF required for phloem (SE and CC) identity (Bonke et al. 2003 Nature); Shahan 2022 metaphloem+CC DE (pct 0.98 vs 0.03); SE and CC clusters in Lyu 2025. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 APL 170 and S32 194 FPKM; Otero 2022 pAPL reporter in PSE then CC and MSE with weak PPP; Roszak 2021 in situ in PSE from the transition zone, then PPP, CC and MSE. Confirms pan-phloem, not SE-specific.

PEAR-family DOF TF of phloem/procambium (Miyashima et al. 2019 Nature); Shahan 2022 protophloem DE (pct 0.90 vs 0.05); pHCA2 reporter in SE and CC (Lyu 2025). Shahan Data S2F mislabels this locus PEAR1/DOF2.4. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 S32 46 FPKM, others <=5. UniProt Q9FM03 names it PHLOEM EARLY DOF HCA2, one of the six PEAR DOFs; it is not PEAR2 (PEAR2 is DOF5.1, AT5G02460).

DOF TF produced in protophloem SE that drives periclinal divisions (Miyashima et al. 2019 Nature); Shahan 2022 protophloem DE (pct 0.88 vs 0.07); reporter in phloem-side cambium/SE (Lyu 2025). Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 S32 155 FPKM, others <=8; Otero 2022 early-PSE curated marker (pPEAR1-del sort: early PSE, MSE, one procambial cell); Roszak 2021 pPEAR1 reporter in PSE and MSE trajectories.
SMXL protein required for phloem formation (Wallner et al. 2017 Curr Biol); Shahan 2022 protophloem DE (pct 0.91 vs 0.10). Also procambium.
OCTOPUS, polar membrane protein needed for protophloem differentiation (Truernit et al. 2012 Plant Cell). Skill table lists it under Procambium.

DOF TF; phloem marker line (Lee et al. 2006 PNAS); Lee 2025 6 d phloem DE; reporter in CPP, SE and CC (Lyu 2025). Nobori 2023 heatmap places it in epidermis (unreliable). Agreement raises low to medium.
Cysteine-rich TM protein (uncharacterized); Shahan 2022 list (Wendrich 2020) and metaphloem+CC DE (pct 1.0 vs 0.05); Lee 2025 3 d phloem DE. Two datasets raise low to medium.

PEAR DOF TF produced in protophloem SE, driving periclinal divisions (Miyashima et al. 2019 Nature, from literature). Early-SE curated marker (Otero 2022) and earliest phloem TF (Roszak 2021); Li 2016 S32 196 FPKM, others <=6.
PEAR-family DOF; early phloem TF (Roszak 2021 Fig 4C) and independent Lyu 2025 reporter in SE and CC; Li 2016 S32 163, APL 39 FPKM, others <=19. Three studies, so high.

Rop GEF; reporter in PSE and adjacent files at the bifurcation, PEAR-dependent, ectopic expression drives periclinal divisions (Roszak 2021 Fig 2D-E); reused by Lyu 2025. Not phloem-specific in the whole root: Li 2016 COBL9 (hair) sort 67 vs S32 8 FPKM. Formative-division stage. Caution: in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting-induced gene list.

Rop GEF marking the cortical division zone in dividing PSE; PEAR-dependent, drives periclinal divisions (Roszak 2021 Fig 2F-G); Lyu 2025 formative-division phloem. Low in Li 2016 (S32 7 FPKM). Formative-division stage.
Rop GEF; reporter in PSE but also outer procambium and pericycle (Roszak 2021 Fig 2D, S4D). Barely detected in Li 2016 (<=3 FPKM).

PEAR-target DOF; transcriptional and translational reporters in the PSE-adjacent ring (early CC, MSE, PPP), also epidermis and weak procambium; 3papl mutant has a root nutrition defect (Otero 2022 ED7a-d). Li 2016 APL 141, S17 119, S32 43 FPKM.

DOF TF; VENUSer and translational reporters in the PSE-adjacent ring, also columella and epidermis (Otero 2022 ED7e-g). Li 2016 APL 51, S17 37, PET111 18 FPKM. In secondary-growth roots it marks CPP (Phloem_Parenchyma row).
MAKR5-3xYFP sorting line marks all PSE-adjacent cells in the meristem and the whole pericycle in the mature root (Otero 2022 ED1a). Li 2016 APL 80, S17 49 FPKM.

Uncharacterized PEAR target; VENUSer ring around PSE at enucleation, shifting to mature pericycle (Otero 2022 ED5a, ED6). Li 2016 APL 180, S17 189 FPKM. Caution: in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting-induced gene list.

Phloem protein 2-B1; cloned reporter and curated ring gene in the authors' code (Otero 2022; image not accessed). Li 2016 APL 123, S17 67 FPKM. Caution: in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting-induced gene list.
Class III peroxidase; VENUSer reporter in an extended ring including procambium (Otero 2022 ED5a). Not specific: Li 2016 APL 965, S17 827, S32 225 FPKM.
DOF TF; pCDF2::VENUSer broad phloem pole, broader than the PAPLs (Otero 2022 ED7h). Li 2016 broad (<=55 FPKM). Weak marker.

GATA TF; S32 protophloem marker line (Lee et al. 2006 PNAS); Shahan 2022 protophloem DE (pct 0.65 vs 0.02). Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 S32 sort (the GATA20/S32 promoter line itself) 376 FPKM vs <=30 elsewhere; with Shahan 2022 protophloem DE this raises medium to high.

NAC TF driving SE enucleation (Furuta et al. 2014 Science); reporter in SE, 40x enriched in Lyu 2025 SE cluster. Update 2026-10-20: Otero 2022 mature-PSE reporter (ED1c) and trajectory order APL>NAC086>NEN4; Roszak 2021 pNAC86 H2B-YFP marks PSE domains V-VII; Li 2016 S32 107, APL 73 FPKM.

Callose synthase for sieve-plate callose (Xie et al. 2011 Plant J); reporter in SE, 169x in Lyu 2025 SE cluster. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 S32 98, APL 43 FPKM, others <=3; Otero 2022 late-SE curated marker; Roszak 2021 pCALS7 sorting/imaging reporter.

Synaptotagmin D; SE reporter 13/13 roots (Lyu 2025), 73x enriched. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 S32 159, APL 122, S18 80 FPKM; sorted-population agreement with the Lyu reporter raises medium to high (some xylem-pole signal).

Multiple C2 domain transmembrane protein; SE reporter 10/10 roots (Lyu 2025), 84x enriched. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 S32 124, APL 91 FPKM, others 0; sorted-population agreement raises medium to high.

NAC TF redundant with NAC086 for SE enucleation (Furuta et al. 2014 Science, from literature). Mature-PSE reporter (Otero 2022 ED1c); lost in the pear sextuple and a top GRN regulator (Roszak 2021); Li 2016 S32 62, APL 57 FPKM, others <=5.

NAC45/86-dependent exonuclease for SE enucleation (Furuta 2014, from literature); pNEN4::H2B-YFP marks very late PSE (Roszak 2021) and ends the Otero 2022 PSE trajectory. Li 2016 APL 89, S32 30 FPKM, others <=2. Very late stage only.

Inositol polyphosphate 5-phosphatase needed for protophloem continuity (from literature). pCVP2 early-PSE sorting reporter (Roszak 2021) and early-SE curated marker (Otero 2022; same lab, one source); Li 2016 S32 67 FPKM, others <=16. Independent agreement, so high. Early PSE.
Rho-of-plants GTPase; reporter-validated PSE-abundant expression in the transit-amplifying domain (Roszak 2021 Fig 2C, S4). Li 2016 weak (S32 16, WOX5 15 FPKM). Early PSE.
NAC TF; early-SE curated marker (Otero 2022 Fig 1; no reporter in the accessible text). Li 2016 S32 80 FPKM, others <=6. Agreement raises low to medium. Early PSE.
NAC TF; promoter of the pNAC57 PSE sorting reporter (Roszak 2021; domain not stated). Li 2016 S32 80 FPKM, APL 10, others <=1. Agreement raises low to medium.
Secondary-wall NAC; pNAC73 late-PSE sorting reporter (Roszak 2021). Not exclusive: Li 2016 S18 xylem 83 vs S32 11 FPKM. Caution: in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting-induced gene list.
Secondary-wall NAC named as a late-PSE gene (Roszak 2021 Table S7 caption; Fig S7 not seen). Not exclusive: Li 2016 S18 xylem 217 vs S32 28 FPKM.

C2H2 zinc finger; late-PSE, PEAR-dependent, overexpression arrests the cell cycle (Roszak 2021 Fig 4J-K; ID in the paper text). Not exclusive: Li 2016 S18 519, APL 93, S32 80 FPKM; also differentiating xylem.
ZAT14 homolog with the same late-PSE expression and overexpression phenotype (Roszak 2021; ID in the paper text). Low in Li 2016 (<=10 FPKM).

Companion-cell sucrose/H+ symporter for phloem loading (Truernit & Sauer 1995; Gottwald et al. 2000 PNAS); seedling MERFISH (Lee 2025) and CC cluster in Lyu 2025. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 APL sort 357 FPKM (S17 43, S18 34); Otero 2022 mature-CC reporter (ED1c, ED10h).

Plasma-membrane H+-ATPase of companion cells; Shahan 2022 metaphloem+CC DE (pct 0.99 vs 0.04); MERFISH in stem/flower, not root (Lee 2025). Update 2026-10-20: Otero 2022 CC curated marker and CC-cluster DE; Li 2016 APL sort 267, S32 53, others <=17 FPKM. Independent agreement raises medium to high.

ERF TF; CC reporter 13/13 roots (Lyu 2025), ~260x enriched. Update 2026-10-20: Not supported in young roots: Li 2016 APL sort only 4 FPKM but 101 in cycloheximide-treated root (stress/CHX-inducible). Use in secondary-growth roots only.
Uncharacterized; CC reporter 6/6 roots (Lyu 2025; also Otero et al. 2022), ~315x enriched. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 APL sort 17 FPKM, others <=1; sorted-population agreement raises medium to high.

Cytokinin biosynthesis enzyme expressed in phloem companion cells (Takei et al. 2004 JBC); CC reporter in Lyu 2025, 74x. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 APL sort 27 FPKM, others <=3 (Mat zone 7); agreement raises medium to high.

Subtilase; CC reporter 10/10 roots (Lyu 2025), 78x. Update 2026-10-20: Otero 2022 pSBT4.12::YFPer CC reporter (ED10c,e), independent of Lyu 2025, so medium to high. Caution: Li 2016 S17 (pericycle) sort is nearly as high as APL (1157 vs 1326 FPKM).

Heavy-metal-associated protein of companion cells; mature-CC reporter (Otero 2022 ED1c); phloem function from Tian et al. 2010 (from literature, not re-checked). Li 2016 APL sort 380 FPKM, others <=17. Independent agreement, so high.
Phosphoinositide phospholipase C5; new CC gene confirmed by VENUSer reporter (Otero 2022 ED1b). Li 2016 APL 605 FPKM but E30 117, not specific.
Uncharacterized LURP-one-related protein; CC gene confirmed by VENUSer reporter (Otero 2022 ED1b). Li 2016 APL sort 94 FPKM, others <=13 (Mat zone 29). Independent agreement, so high.
MYB-related (APL paralog); pSAPL::YFPer sorting line marks CC and weaker MSE 90-120 um from the QC (Otero 2022 ED1a, ED2g). Li 2016 APL sort 180 FPKM, others <=10. Independent agreement, so high.
Metacaspase 3; AHA3-correlated CC candidate with a cloned reporter (Otero 2022 Table S7; image paywalled). Li 2016 APL sort 406 FPKM, E30 60, others <=58. Agreement raises low to medium.

Cysteine-rich TM protein; AHA3-correlated CC candidate (Otero 2022 code; pattern not accessed). Li 2016 broad (APL 328, E30 100, S18 98, S32 96 FPKM). Caution: in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting-induced gene list.
Tetraspanin; conductive phloem-associated parenchyma (CPP) reporter 19/19 with lineage sectors (Lyu 2025). Shared with SE. Secondary-growth roots.

DOF TF; CPP reporter and papl triple mutant reduces de novo SE (Lyu 2025). Not CPP-restricted (higher in mature xylem parenchyma); Nobori 2023 panel 'Stele/procambium'. Update 2026-10-20: In the primary root Otero 2022 reporters (ED7e-g) put CDF4/PAPL2 in the PSE-adjacent ring, columella and epidermis; added separately under Phloem. CPP here applies to secondary-growth roots.
WRKY TF; CPP reporter 12/12 (Lyu 2025) but only 1.3x vs SE.

NAC master switch for protoxylem vessel differentiation (Kubo et al. 2005 Genes Dev); Shahan 2022 protoxylem DE (pct 0.96 vs 0.01). Not specific in the Nobori panel. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 S18 (maturing xylem) 402, S4 26 FPKM.

NAC master switch for metaxylem vessels (Kubo et al. 2005 Genes Dev); 17x in Lyu 2025 late-vessel cluster (UMAP only). Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 S18 (maturing xylem) 123 FPKM, others <=2; sorted-population agreement raises medium to high. Metaxylem.

MYB master switch for secondary walls in vessels and fibers; Shahan 2022 protoxylem DE (pct 0.98 vs 0.01); highest in Lyu 2025 late vessel. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 S18 2104 FPKM, S4 20, others <=13.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase; Shahan 2022 protoxylem DE (pct 0.98 vs 0.01); MERFISH in stem xylem (Lee 2025). Also fibers.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase; Shahan 2022 protoxylem DE (pct 0.99 vs 0.04) and Lee 2025 xylem DE. Also fibers. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 S18 2684 FPKM, others <=30.
Secondary-wall cellulose synthase; Shahan 2022 protoxylem DE (pct 0.96 vs 0.01); seedling and stem MERFISH (Lee 2025). Also fibers. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 S18 3072 FPKM, others <=31.
Thermospermine synthase restricting xylem differentiation (Muniz et al. 2008 Development); metaxylem marker (Shahan 2022 list); vessel reporter 14/14 (Lyu 2025); stem MERFISH (Lee 2025).
bHLH of xylem precursors controlling vascular periclinal divisions (De Rybel et al. 2013 Dev Cell); Shahan 2022 protoxylem marker list. Early xylem only.
source: 10.1016/j.devcel.2022.01.008; De Rybel et al. 2013 Dev Cell

basis: Germin-like protein; Shahan 2022 metaxylem DE (pct 0.97 vs 0.03), vessel-identity reporter 14/14 (Lyu 2025), Nobori 2023 panel 'Elongating-Xylem'. Two independent studies raise medium to high.

Laccase; xylem in Shahan 2022 list (Wendrich 2020), PHYTOMap panel xylem (Nobori 2023), vessel-identity reporter 12/12 (Lyu 2025). Nobori's LAC6-driven cluster 0 is labelled Epidermis, so primary-root specificity is unclear.

Xylem cysteine peptidase of TE autolysis (Avci et al. 2008 Plant J); stem MERFISH (Lee 2025) and xylem-cluster DE. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 S18 23130 FPKM vs S4 211 and <=157 elsewhere; sorted-population agreement raises medium to high.
ROP GEF patterning secondary-wall pits in metaxylem vessels (Oda & Fukuda 2012 Science); late-vessel reporter 13/15 (Lyu 2025), 190x.
Auxin influx carrier; vessel-identity reporter 20/20 (Lyu 2025), 18x.
bHLH (PHY RAPIDLY REGULATED 2); expanding-vessel reporter 16/17 (Lyu 2025), 40x.
NDR1/HIN1-like; xylem in Shahan 2022 list and PHYTOMap stele (Nobori 2023). Conflict: reported in companion cells in leaves.
Xylem cysteine peptidase 1, tracheary-element autolysis (Avci et al. 2008 Plant J, from literature). Li 2016 S18 (maturing xylem) 7930 FPKM, S4 98, others <=37.
Laccase for secondary-wall lignin (irx12; from literature). Li 2016 S18 5903 FPKM, others <=37. Also fibers.
ELMO/CED-12 family (uncharacterized); young xylem parenchyma reporter 10/11 next to cambium (Lyu 2025 Fig 2a), 6x. Secondary-growth roots.

Lipid transfer protein; maturing xylem parenchyma reporter 14/15 (Lyu 2025 Fig 2c), 8.6x. Secondary-growth roots. Update 2026-10-20: CONFLICT: in 5-6 d roots Li 2016 puts it in the S17 pericycle sort (305 FPKM) and S4 (31), not S18 xylem (6). Lyu's call is for secondary-growth roots; in primary-root data read it as pericycle (separate Pericycle row).

Uncharacterized (hypersensitivity-related protein-like); mature xylem parenchyma reporter 23/25 (Lyu 2025 Fig 2b), 8x. Secondary-growth roots. Update 2026-10-20: Li 2016 S18 (maturing xylem, vessel-dominated) 726 FPKM, COBL9 19, others <=4: supports xylem-pole identity, but there is no xylem-parenchyma-only population, so not raised.
Stigma-specific Stig1 family; mature xylem parenchyma reporter 19/21 (Lyu 2025), 11x. Secondary-growth roots.
UDP-glycosyltransferase; maturing xylem parenchyma reporter 11/16 (Lyu 2025), 5.7x.

Outward K+ channel loading K+ into the xylem from stelar cells (Gaymard et al. 1998 Cell; characterized_markers.tsv high for 'xylem parenchyma (with pericycle)'). No study here resolves XP from pericycle (Li 2016: S17 pericycle sort 37 FPKM), so medium; use with a pericycle marker as a negative. Caution: in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting-induced gene list.
NAC master switch for fiber secondary walls (Mitsuda et al. 2007 Plant Cell); weak in Lyu 2025 data (1.1x), fiber call unvalidated.
CLE peptide; fiber reporter in only 10/23 roots and peaks also in maturing xylem parenchyma (Lyu 2025).

PYK10-binding jacalin lectin; periderm reporter 24/24 roots (Lyu 2025 Fig 1e), 12x; JA-inducible. Update 2026-10-20: In 5-6 d roots (no periderm) Li 2016 shows broad expression (GL2 1786, COBL9 1616, WER 1303, PET111 783 FPKM). Periderm-specific only in secondary-growth roots.
2-oxoglutarate dioxygenase; periderm reporter 16/16 (Lyu 2025), 13x.
Bet v1/MLP-like; young periderm reporter 12/12 (Lyu 2025), 14x.

Class III peroxidase of phellem (Xiao et al. 2020 Curr Biol); 6x in Lyu 2025 periderm (UMAP only). Update 2026-10-20: CONFLICT: in 5-6 d roots (no periderm) Li 2016 shows it mature-endodermis-specific (E30 160, SCR 21 FPKM, others <=2). Use only in secondary-growth roots; in primary-root data it marks mature endodermis. Lowered medium to low.

Class III peroxidase; periderm reporter 14/15 (Lyu 2025) but mean expression is highest in myrosin idioblasts. Update 2026-10-20: CONFLICT: in 5-6 d roots Li 2016 shows it mature-endodermis-specific (E30 143 FPKM, others <=7). Use only in secondary-growth roots.
Myrosinase of glucosinolate-myrosinase defense, stored in myrosin cells; reporter 26/26 + Coomassie staining (Lyu 2025), ~2000x.
bHLH TF required for myrosin-cell differentiation (Li & Sack 2014 Plant Cell; Shirakawa 2014) and guard cells in shoots; pFAMA:GUS 10/10 in root MI (Lyu 2025), 900x.
APC/C activator of G2/M; MERFISH dividing cells (Lee 2025 ED Fig 3d) and Lee 2025 'Dividing' DE.
Kinesin for cell-plate expansion (cytokinesis); MERFISH dividing cells (Lee 2025 Fig 2c).
Cytokinesis-specific syntaxin (from literature); Otero 2022 used it to flag cell-cycle identity in its early-PSE cluster. Li 2016 highest in meristem-rich sorts (S4 201, S32 157, WOX5 139 FPKM).
Mitotic B-type cyclin, G2/M (from literature); cell-cycle check in the Otero 2022 code.
Aurora kinase of mitosis (from literature); cell-cycle check in the Otero 2022 code.

Blue-copper-binding protein (stress/wound-responsive). Li 2016 sorted whole root 199 vs unsorted 0.09 FPKM (log2FC ~7.5); in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting list (independent), so medium. Not a cell type: flags protoplast-induced signal.
Tyrosine aminotransferase 3 (wound/JA-inducible). Li 2016 sorted 324 vs unsorted 0.95 FPKM (log2FC ~7.4); in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting list.
Drought/heat-responsive AP2 TF. Li 2016 sorted 569 vs unsorted 3.9 FPKM (log2FC ~6.9); in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting list.
Wound/ROS-responsive ERF. Li 2016 sorted 133 vs unsorted 0.26 FPKM (log2FC ~6.7); in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting list.
Stress-responsive ERF. Li 2016 sorted 128 vs unsorted 0.26 FPKM (log2FC ~6.7); in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting list.
Small heat-shock protein. Li 2016 sorted 131 vs unsorted 0.68 FPKM (log2FC ~6.3); in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting list.
Rapid stress-responsive WRKY TF. Li 2016 sorted 192 vs unsorted 2.6 FPKM (log2FC ~5.7); in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting list.
Calmodulin-like protein (hypoxia/touch-inducible). Li 2016 sorted 132 vs unsorted 1.2 FPKM (log2FC ~5.9); in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting list.
Small heat-shock protein. Li 2016 sorted 68 vs unsorted 0 FPKM; in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting list.
Touch-inducible xyloglucan endotransglucosylase. Li 2016 sorted 97 vs unsorted 1.4 FPKM (log2FC ~5.4); in the Shahan 2022 protoplasting list.
